After raw result return, typed inspection is a separate logical caller boundary. Observe conversion failure once without consuming the pooled result or changing its reference ownership; disposal keeps its existing contract.

Boundaries.Name: native-pooled-inspection
Boundaries.Contract: Native pooled GetResult owns final transport inspection. Keep response references, token checks and pool return intact. Never add a universal ValueTask wrapper.

Boundaries.Name: typed-converter-inspection
Boundaries.Contract: Converted pooled GetResult keeps ownership through converter invocation and response disposal. Conversion and cleanup failures belong to this caller, not the underlying raw response.

Boundaries.Name: byte-result-inspection
Boundaries.Contract: Byte result inspection owns final failure and native pool lifetime.

Boundaries.Name: raw-catalog-dispatch
Boundaries.Contract: Public catalog dispatch owns validation before delegating to raw or typed command construction and through returned result creation. A returned RespireResult keeps its existing ownership.

Boundaries.Name: raw-dispatch-helper
Boundaries.Contract: Borrow the enclosing Execute caller owner; raw retry and conversion cannot independently publish that caller failure.

Boundaries.Name: catalog-dispatch-helper
Boundaries.Contract: Borrow the public catalog caller owner through metadata validation and dispatch.

Boundaries.Name: interpolated-dispatch
Boundaries.Contract: Own handler validation and command construction before delegated dispatch; keep owner through result conversion and cleanup.

Boundaries.Name: interpolated-helper
Boundaries.Contract: Delegate final publication to the public interpolated entry.

Boundaries.Name: connection-string-parsing
Boundaries.Contract: Connect(string) starts ownership before Parse; direct Parse remains configuration validation, not a Redis command observation.

Boundaries.Name: connection-setup
Boundaries.Contract: Own credentials, handshake, authentication, setup parsing and failed-connect cleanup. Connect(string) and ConnectAny borrow or transfer their enclosing caller lease, never count a nested setup twice.

Boundaries.Name: physical-connect-helper
Boundaries.Contract: Physical attempts borrow setup ownership. Recovered connection attempts are handled retries; pool generations do not create caller ownership.

Boundaries.Name: cache-producer
Boundaries.Contract: Producer handles one shared attempt. It cannot publish every waiter final failure; each logical waiter retains separate owner even with one shared exception.

Boundaries.Name: cache-typed-producer
Boundaries.Contract: Shared GET producer owns only its borrowed attempt. Typed conversion belongs to each caller after sharing.

Boundaries.Name: cache-waiter
Boundaries.Contract: Each coalesced caller keeps a distinct final owner through cancellation, response ownership transfer and cleanup.

Boundaries.Name: cache-typed-waiter
Boundaries.Contract: Keep each coalesced caller owner through typed converter and response cleanup; do not count the shared producer as the waiter.

Boundaries.Name: cache-aside-producer
Boundaries.Contract: Factory, GET and SET borrow the GetOrSet caller owner. Shared producer failures retain separate waiter ownership.

Boundaries.Name: upload-payload-read
Boundaries.Contract: Source stream reads and deferred short reads borrow upload ownership. Keep ownership through active fill completion and cleanup before final failure.

Boundaries.Name: download-payload-read
Boundaries.Contract: Once GET returns a stream, each public payload read is a separate logical caller. Preserve stream cancellation, pipe drain and receive ordering; do not hold GET ownership forever.

Boundaries.Name: fan-out
Boundaries.Contract: Keep public fan-out ownership through endpoint discovery, all target outcomes and cleanup. Public facet validation remains in its enclosing declared owner.

Boundaries.Name: fan-out-target
Boundaries.Contract: Each target keeps its per-node returned failure through converter and pool cleanup. Parent aggregates outcomes; do not publish the same node failure as both target and parent.

Boundaries.Name: deferred-execution
Boundaries.Contract: Execute owns dispatch, aggregate replies and cleanup. Queue-time validation belongs to its entry; later pending inspections have independent ownership.

Boundaries.Name: deferred-inspection
Boundaries.Contract: Pending.Result owns caller final inspection. Repeated final inspection of one owner generation is harmless; independent callers remain distinct.

Boundaries.Name: deferred-awaiter
Boundaries.Contract: Delegate final inspection to pending Result without consuming or replacing the deferred result contract.

Boundaries.Name: transaction-commit
Boundaries.Contract: Commit owns preflight, watch validation, all replies and UNWATCH/dedicated cleanup. Pending inspection remains separate.

Boundaries.Name: caller-cleanup
Boundaries.Contract: Explicit disposal is its own caller operation; cleanup inside another command borrows that command owner and finishes before publication.

Boundaries.Name: internal-health-probe
Boundaries.Contract: Probe failures returned as diagnostic data are internal observations, not command caller failures. Explicit health-call validation still belongs to its public surface owner.

Boundaries.Name: internal-topology-query
Boundaries.Contract: Background topology discovery records internal failures and never manufactures a caller final owner.
